Description: DPDP Section 16 Advisory: Outbound HTTP request to Azure ML endpoint. Ensure the endpoint URL  points to a certified Indian cloud datacenter (e.g., Azure South India / Central India)  in accordance with cross-border transfer restrictions and the DPDP Act.

DPDP Section 8 Violation: Passwords hashed using unsalted SHA-256 (`hashlib.sha256`).  Section 8 mandates robust reasonable security safeguards. Use salted PBKDF2 (`hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac`),  bcrypt, or argon2 to protect credentials against precomputation and rainbow table attacks.

DPDP Section 8 Advisory: Direct plain-text JSONL persistence for audit logs and student identifiers.  Ensure sensitive student audit logs are protected with at-rest encryption or restricted filesystem ACLs.
